properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 1 at 9:44AM MST until November 2 at 7:00PM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...South Central Archuleta County in southwestern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of you

properties.areaDesc: Johnson and Bartlett Mesas Including Raton Pass
properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 1 at 9:46AM MST until November 2 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Johnson and Bartlett Mesas Including Raton Pass.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs may be blown down. Expect strong crosswinds on area roadways.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 1 at 11:58AM EST by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
At 1157 AM EST, National Weather Service meteorologists were tracking
a strong thunderstorm 10 miles west of Loxahatchee NWR, or 13 miles
southeast of Belle Glade, moving northwest at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 45 to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree
properties.instruction:
These winds can down small tree limbs and branches, and blow around
unsecured small objects. Seek shelter in a safe building until the
storm passes.
